ORDINANCE NO. 4-A
AN ORDINANCE TO REPEAL ORDINANCE NO. 4
WHEREAS, on June 2, 1998, the Board of County Commissioners for Clear Creek
County (hereinafter "Board"), introduced Ordinance No. 4, an Ordinance for the Use and Control
of Lands Open for Recreational Uses and after a second reading on July 21, 1998, the Board
adopted Ordinance No. 4; and
WHEREAS, Ordinance No. 4 was based on the existence of easements being granted by
the owners of Historic District Public Lands Commission lands to the County, with respect to
their lands in the boundaries of the Georgetown - Silver Plume National Historic Landmark
District and those easements have expired by their terms and have not been renewed; and
WHEREAS, because the easements that provided the bases of Ordinance 4 have expired,
Ordinance No. 4 can no longer be enforced; and
WHEREAS, the Board of County Commissioners believes that it is in the best interest of
the Citizens of the County to repeal Ordinance No. 4.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Board of County Commissioners for
Clear Creek County, that Ordinance No. 4 is hereby repealed in full.
BE IT EVEN FURTHER ORDAINED by the Board of County Commissioners that,
upon adoption, this Ordinance shall be published by title only in a newspaper(s) of general
circulation In the County.
INTRODUCED, FIRST READ, ORDERED PUBLISHED IN FULL AND SET FOR
PUBLIC HEARING THIS 7th_DAY OF JULY, 2026.
BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS
CLEAR CREEK COUNTY
Rebecca Lloyd, Chair
Jatettiln-Bl
Jodie Hartman Ball, Commissioner
George Marlin, Commissioner
